children: Stimcell Energetics Inc. reported a full-year 2026 comprehensive loss of ($890.06K) and a net loss of ($895.38K), with diluted loss per share of ($0.04), reflecting wider losses versus fiscal 2025 as the company continues pre-revenue operations and invests in product development and commercialization.
¹ Reported as “Comprehensive loss”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.
Product development: The company engaged ADM Tronics to redesign its eBalance® product into a compact consumer home device, with development expected to take approximately nine months.
Revenue status: Stimcell remained pre-revenue in FY2026, generating no product revenue as it focuses on commercialization.

R&D and operations: R&D spending increased materially as resources shifted to redesign and consumer optimization; corporate communications and G&A rose due to increased marketing and public outreach activity.
